name: Omatron
author: Zedster07
description: Speak or type, and your desktop acts — on a leash you own. Omatron replaces Omarchy's dictation with its own speech stack, then escalates through four tiers: a declared intent registry answers known phrases instantly and offline; an AI writes new commands for the rest, shown before they run; and an agent that can see and click the screen takes what commands cannot express. Every action passes one default-deny policy with an approval overlay, an audit line and a kill switch. It can delegate independent work to parallel subagents, schedule reminders and recurring tasks, and confine any agent to the desktop tools alone.

barWidget.description: Spoken commands, an approval overlay, and policy-gated agent control.

schema.label: Panel opens on
schema.description: Which section the panel shows when you click the bar icon. Everything else — speech engine, API key, AI assistance, policy — is configured inside the panel itself, so there is only one place to change a setting.
